title: Feed NM cable through an outlet box's push-in clamp: past its sprung one-way tab, until 150 mm is inside, then let go
instruction: Push the end of the cable into the outlet box through its cable clamp and pull it in until about 150 mm of cable is inside the box, then let go.
context: During residential rough-in, an electrician feeds NM cable through the integral clamp of an installed outlet box. The clamp resists withdrawal. The task measures intact cable inside the box before stripping or making a connection.
setup: Secure a 38 × 89 × 490 mm stud upright. Nail the black single-gang box to the side of the stud, with its open face toward the YAM arms and its active cable entry on top. The rim stands 13 mm proud of the stud. The active top entry is 145 mm above the work surface and the front lip of the opening is 380 mm forward of the line between the two arm bases. Route 450 mm of intact 14/2 NM-B over the upper timber support with the free end hanging above the entry. Both grippers begin in READY.
scoring: Read at the end of the trial (person check in brackets). 1.0 (ends the trial): the cable passes through the entry opening with the clamp tab resting on it (photo), 130-170 mm of cable inside the box measured along the cable from the entry wall's inner face to the cut end (tape measure), both grippers 120 mm or more from the cable and the cable still for 1 s (video: no part of the last 200 mm moving more than 5 mm). 0.5: through the clamp, released and still, but the length is outside 130-170 mm. Otherwise 0 (not through the clamp, still held, or moving).
reset_notes: Release the integral tab, remove the sample, restore the fixture to its seed marks, and lay the stock over the upper support with the free end hanging down toward the entry.
fidelity: The Allied Moulded P-181RK drawing specifies a 58.4 × 95.3 × 68.6 mm box body. The modeled entry is 13 × 14.5 mm. The active molded tongue is 12.5 mm wide and 15.5 mm long. These local dimensions and the clamp drive are simulation estimates. Physical entry clearance and opening force have not been measured. The README links the original drawing. PhysX simulates the 30-link cable and hinged tab at 240 Hz.
run_limit: 3600 control steps (3 min at 20 Hz). The trial also ends as soon as the score reaches 1.0.
scores: The scripted reference earned 1.0 at step 1,338 of 3,600. At termination the box retained 130.62 mm of cable, the tongue angle was 42.28°, and the nearest fingertip was 273.09 mm from the cable. Dream-1 earned 0.0 in 3,600 steps with 357 model requests.
